windowing.events_tracked: non-static requests only for path/time history; all requests for hit counters

features.name: SAGE_Session_Depth
features.description: Total number of non-static requests within the rolling window for the current session.

features.name: SAGE_Temporal_Variance
features.description: Coefficient of variation of inter-arrival times between consecutive non-static requests. Returns 0 if <2 requests.

features.name: SAGE_Request_Velocity
features.description: Rate of non-static requests. Minimum duration bound at 0.001s to prevent division by zero.

features.name: SAGE_Behavioral_Diversity
features.description: Entropy calculated over the canonical paths of the non-static requests in the rolling window.

features.name: SAGE_Endpoint_Concentration
features.description: Ratio of the most frequently visited canonical non-static path to the total number of non-static requests in the window.

features.name: SAGE_Cart_Ratio
features.description: Ratio of requests starting with /cart or /checkout to all requests (including static) in the session.

features.name: SAGE_Asset_Skip_Ratio
features.description: Ratio of non-static requests to all requests in the session. Defaults to 1.0 if total_hits is 0.

predicates.canonicalPath: strip query params (?), strip fragments (#), deduplicate slashes, remove trailing slash, lowercase
